title: GO UP
topCaption:
"日本の女エミネム"
と呼ばれる怪物ラッパー

captions.translation: タカタタタカタタカタタカタタ

captions.original: Working like an alien but still many ahead of me
captions.translation: 宇宙人みたいに働いてもまだ先は長い

captions.original: I quit slacking and begging and put excruciating efforts in it
captions.translation: サボるのも媚びるのも止めて努力してみた

captions.original: Believe in em, salute em and then bruise em repeat it
captions.translation: 彼らを信じて敬って殴って繰り返す

captions.original: Wait a minute, why are you trying to make me the villain?
captions.translation: なんで私を悪役にするの？

captions.original: You'll be mine skin to bone by then
captions.translation: そうなる前にはもうお前を喰ってる

captions.original: I'm giddy giddy giddy giddy giddy did you get it?
captions.translation: 完全にハイになってる 分かるっしょ？
